category: Open-Source Workflow Orchestration & Data Pipeline Automation
methodology: Verified GitHub API and package registry metrics comparing leading open-source workflow orchestrators against commercial Astronomer Cloud and AWS MWAA environments.

repositories.name: Apache Airflow
repositories.description: Apache Airflow - A platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows
repositories.verdict: The definitive industry standard Python DAG orchestrator with the world's largest data provider ecosystem.

repositories.name: Dagster
repositories.description: An orchestration platform for the development, production, and observation of data assets
repositories.verdict: Next-generation software-defined asset (SDA) orchestrator with built-in lineage and rich local testing.

repositories.name: Prefect
repositories.description: Prefect is a workflow orchestration tool empowering developers to build, observe, and react to data pipelines
repositories.verdict: Developer-friendly Python-native decorator orchestration with dynamic workflows and sub-second task dispatch.

repositories.name: Temporal
repositories.description: Temporal service and SDK for durable execution and microservices workflow orchestration
repositories.verdict: Stateful durable execution engine with event-sourced replay history for mission-critical distributed sagas.
